landing: Lunar shuttle landing bay interior: a small docked passenger shuttle on the left seen through a huge airlock window, scuffed deck plating, a wall-mounted emergency kit box, a large sealed cargo crate plastered in packing tape center-right, a round viewport showing Earth in black sky upper right, an intercom panel on the right wall, exit door on the far right
reception: Moon base reception room: an obsessively tidy reception desk center with perfectly aligned objects and a dark metallic paperweight, a stopped analog wall clock on the left wall, a framed motivational poster with a kitten in a spacesuit on the right wall, security door on the far right, door to landing bay on the far left, queue rope barriers with nobody queueing
hub: Moon base central hub atrium: four numbered doors along the curved back wall, a corridor opening on each side wall, a battered coffee vending machine with a black mourning wreath on the left wall, cafeteria tables, a potted fern leaning toward a skylight, a barricaded freight elevator with hazard stripes lower right
corridor: Moon base dormitory corridor: a row of crew cabin doors along the back wall, a large ventilation grate at waist height on the right of the back wall, a cork notice board covered in pinned papers on the far right wall, cable runs along the ceiling, lockers between doors
quarters: Tiny moon base intern cabin, claustrophobic: a narrow bunk filling the left half, a thin metal locker, a broom leaning in the corner, a porthole the size of a dinner plate high on the wall, motivational sticker peeling off the ceiling
engineering: Moon base engineering bay: a pegboard tool wall with painted outlines for every tool and one empty wrench-shaped outline center, a glowing caged fusion reactor on the right wall with warning labels, a cluttered workbench with a disassembled coffee machine on the left, hanging chain hoist, oil stains
lab: Moon base xenolinguistics laboratory: a chalkboard covered in alien glyph transcriptions and angry annotations center, a bulky sample scanner machine on the left, sealed empty specimen cases, an official confiscation notice pinned on the right wall, precise tape grids on the floor
stores: Moon base quartermaster stores: a service counter with a polished call bell front center, towering supply shelves with cryptically labeled boxes on the left, a large wire-mesh confiscation cage on the right containing a kazoo a hot plate a yo-yo and a glowing wrench, forms in wall racks
tunnels: Moon base maintenance tunnel made homey by a stowaway: ducting and pipes everywhere, a cozy nest of insulation panels with a caution-tape pillow on the right, potatoes growing in a repurposed air filter trough with tiny name tags on the left, thousands of tally marks scratched into the wall, warm string of repurposed indicator lights
havisham: Grand but decayed moon base owner's quarters frozen in time: a six-tier wedding-style cake under a glass dome on a banquet table center with a long silver stirrer in the top tier, dozens of stopped clocks on every surface, a grandfather clock on the right, a dust-sheeted portrait on the left wall, an ornate chair, everything under a veil of undisturbed dust, single shaft of harsh window light
minehead: Industrial lunar mine head chamber for Shaft 9: a huge winch and cable drum center, an open-cage mining elevator on the right with its gate ajar, contradictory warning signs bolted to the left wall, hard hats on hooks, drill bits taller than a person, dark shaft mouth descending
doorchamber: Vast ancient chamber deep under the lunar surface: an enormous alien door of dark stone filling the back wall, covered in a glowing ring of amber glyphs, three small key slots at its center, raw rock walls with drill marks, an abandoned 26-year-old survey camp with folding chairs and a dead floodlight lower right, a single emergency intercom bolted to the left rock wall
